tables.path.inArray: {at} is an array, so point inside it with {at}[] or by picking an element
tables.said.ofNeeded: {full}: of is required (the path of the entity or value that gives the shape of the data to tabulate, e.g. Schema:Host)
tables.said.pathNeeded: {full}.{name}[{i}]: path (the path of a value) is required
tables.said.showShape: {full}.{name}[{i}].show: the ways to show are {shows} (label shows an enum's value by its display name, link shows a value that is a card's path as a link)
tables.unnest.shape: unnest is the path of an array field (without [ ])
